findings: The first compile command used the wrong working directory; corrected before the successful compilation.
Initial query validation rejected an empty currency even though it means separate original-currency columns; corrected and the independent arithmetic then passed.
The integration test initially expected422 for a changed signed cursor, while the existing paging protocol correctly returns400; corrected the test.

A read lock on immutable export requests required UPDATE privilege. Removed the unnecessary request-row lock while retaining organization/user locks, immutable triggers, minimum table privileges and fenced job commits. No UPDATE privilege was added.

additional_diagnostics.note: A synthetic raw role change omitted the normal organization authorization-version increment; the fixture now simulates that increment explicitly.
The first browser fixture requested an unused administrator MFA credential. The harness will use the business fixture mode required by this report, without requesting that credential.
